About Moloco:
Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.
Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system.
Moloco Ads
is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet.
Moloco Commerce Media
is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by
CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture)
, the AI system behind every Moloco product.
At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer.
Come build what's next.
The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco
Moloco helps businesses grow through machine learning-powered advertising and measurement. As a TPM supporting our CTV business, you will help shape how CTV products and platforms scale across app, web, and smart TV environments.
You will make an impact by:
Connecting business goals to clear priorities, milestones, and execution plans.
Creating visibility into performance, investment, operational health, and progress against goals.
Aligning Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams around shared outcomes.
Coordinating identity, measurement, reporting, and platform initiatives that improve the CTV experience for customers and partners.
Helping global teams move with greater clarity and predictability across Seoul and other Moloco offices.
The Opportunity
As the TPM for CTV, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs from problem definition through launch and post-launch learning. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Data Science and Machine Learning, Finance, Strategy, Go-to-Market, and customer-facing teams across Moloco.
You will:
Translate CTV strategy and customer needs into a focused roadmap, well-defined workstreams, milestones, and dependencies.
Establish clear planning and communication rhythms that keep teams aligned and leaders informed.
Drive execution across technical and business initiatives, bringing structure to ambiguity and momentum to high-priority work.
Identify risks, surface trade-offs, and guide decisions to resolution through influence and strong stakeholder partnership.
Connect launch plans with measurable outcomes, using data and feedback to improve products and operating practices.
Build effective collaboration across Seoul and Moloco’s global teams.
How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?
This role may be a strong fit if you enjoy turning complex problems into coordinated action and helping teams deliver meaningful outcomes together.
What you bring
Experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs involving Product, Engineering, Data or Machine Learning, Infrastructure, Finance, and/or Go-to-Market teams.
Strong program-management fundamentals, including problem definition, scoping, planning, milestone and dependency management, risk mitigation, and concise progress communication.
Technical depth to understand system architecture, technical design documents, system components, and data flows, and to engage productively with technical leaders.
Comfort planning and communicating in environments where outcomes, priorities, or technical approaches evolve over time.
The judgment and influence to bring clarity to ambiguity, make trade-offs visible, and move decisions forward without relying on formal authority.
Excellent written and spoken English communication for collaboration with colleagues and leaders across global offices.
The ability to manage multiple workstreams while balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.
3+ years of technical program management or engineering management experience.
5+ years of experience working directly with software, cloud, or data engineering teams.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience that will help you thrive
Background as a TPM, Technical Program Manager, Engineering Program Manager, Product Manager, engineer, or in a comparable technical leadership role.
Experience in AdTech, advertising platforms, DSP or SSP, measurement, identity, CTV/OTT, streaming, commerce, or large-scale data platforms.
Experience connecting business outcomes such as revenue, cost, customer activation, quality, or reliability to technical execution.
Experience working across US and APAC teams or in a globally distributed organization.
We welcome candidates from a range of technical domains. Experience with CTV or advertising is valuable, and strong program leadership, technical judgment, and the ability to learn a new domain quickly are equally important.
Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:
Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.
Moloco Values:
Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.
Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.
Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.
